parsed.summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, but it lacks updates to the backend code and tests.

issues.description: The PR does not update the backend code to use the new get/set_antialiased methods, which means the functionality will not be effective.
The PR does not add any tests for the new get/set_antialiased methods, which is necessary to ensure the functionality works as expected.
The PR does not update the Annotation class, which is also a Text object, to include the new get/set_antialiased methods.
